name: Report catalog, issued reports and downloads
summary: The list of a project's reports, what an issued report means after data is corrected, and downloadable report links.

nfr.statement: How long issued report files and their download links remain available.
nfr.open_question: The old PRD says both 30 days (storage) and 7 days (link). What is the intended retention and link lifetime?

requirements.title: The report catalog is tidied and sorted by recency
requirements.statement: A project's report catalog is cleaned up when read. A missing or malformed catalog becomes empty, aliased section names are merged (keeping the first one seen), and reports are sorted newest first. A report job can exist with no catalog entry.
open_checks: Reconcile catalog, job row, file URL and expiry, download log and recipient notification after failure or retry
The demo saw a catalog and a configured send time; neither proves generated contents or actual delivery

acceptance_criteria.given: A project whose stored catalog isn't a list
acceptance_criteria.then: An empty list is returned rather than an error

requirements.title: Reports reflect corrected progress
requirements.statement: Report values come from current progress, which can go down after corrections or physical loss, and is recalculated when a takeoff error is corrected. What happens to reports already issued before a correction is open (DEC-004).

sources.title: Product walkthrough and clarifications recorded in the 2026-10-28 ledger

acceptance_criteria.given: An erroneous takeoff for floor 2 is corrected from 100 to 80
acceptance_criteria.when: A new progress report covering last month is generated
acceptance_criteria.then: Last month's percentages for floor 2 use 80

requirements.title: Downloadable capture report
requirements.statement: Users can request an HTML report of all of a project's active captures. A download link is emailed to them, and the report is kept in cloud storage for a limited time.
requirements.rationale: The PRD says the report is kept for 30 days but the link lasts 7. Product to reconcile (RPT-NFR-003).

acceptance_criteria.when: A user requests the capture report
acceptance_criteria.then: The report includes every active snapshot
